title: Toot Raft
one_line: Four pigs on a spinning raft, one spiky river, and nothing but toots to steer with.
how_to_play: Press 1 2 3 4 or tap a pig to toot and push the raft away from its side; arrow keys, WASD or tapping the water push the raft that way; toot the same pig 3 times fast for a ROCKET TOOT.
description: Pip, Ham, Bun and Lou are stuck on a round raft drifting down a river lined with spiky walls, logs, whirlpools and mines. Each pig toots out of its own side, so every toot spins and shoves the raft. Grab beans, dodge hazards and reach the finish across three rivers (Lazy Creek, Spiky Bends and Gas Gauntlet) plus a fresh Daily River every day. Spend lifetime beans in the Wardrobe on hats and outfits for each pig. Works on phones and computers.
